course.title: Unit 6 Nature and us-Part B--【例句】
course.description: Part B（What happens in bad weather?）

sentences.content: I'm sorry. The wind is very strong outside.
sentences.english: I'm sorry . The wind is very strong outside
sentences.chinese: 很抱歉。外面的风很大。

sentences.content: We can't go on our trip this morning.
sentences.english: We can't go on our trip this morning
sentences.chinese: 我们今天早上没法去旅行了。

sentences.content: I agree. Strong winds are often dangerous.
sentences.english: I agree . Strong winds are often dangerous
sentences.chinese: 我同意。强风往往很危险。

wordDetails.definition: be（现在式）: 构成现在进行时

sentences.content: There will be heavy rain in the afternoon too.
sentences.english: There will be heavy rain in the afternoon too
sentences.chinese: 下午也将有大雨。

sentences.content: Mike, stay in the hotel with Mum and close the windows.
sentences.english: Mike , stay in the hotel with Mum and close the windows
sentences.chinese: Mike，和妈妈一起待在酒店里，把窗户关上。

sentences.content: I'll go to buy some umbrellas and raincoats.
sentences.english: I'll go to buy some umbrellas and raincoats
sentences.chinese: 我要去买些雨伞和雨衣。

sentences.content: There is a small shop in the hotel.
sentences.english: There is a small shop in the hotel
sentences.chinese: 酒店里有一家小商店。

sentences.content: You can buy them there.
sentences.english: You can buy them there
sentences.chinese: 你可以在那里买到它们。

sentences.content: Please don't worry! It'll be a fine day tomorrow.
sentences.english: Please don't worry ! It'll be a fine day tomorrow
sentences.chinese: 请别担心！明天会是个好天气。

sentences.content: What do you usually do at the weekend?
sentences.english: What do you usually do at the weekend ?
sentences.chinese: 你周末通常做什么？

sentences.content: I usually go to the park.
sentences.english: I usually go to the park
sentences.chinese: 我通常去公园。

sentences.content: But this Saturday there will be strong winds.
sentences.english: But this Saturday there will be strong winds
sentences.chinese: 但这个周六将会有强风。

sentences.content: There is often fog on the sea in spring.
sentences.english: There is often fog on the sea in spring
sentences.chinese: 春天海面上常有雾。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.content: There is heavy rain in summer. Sometimes there are floods.
sentences.english: There is heavy rain in summer . Sometimes there are floods
sentences.chinese: 夏季常有暴雨，有时还会引发洪水。

sentences.content: Autumn is windy.
sentences.english: Autumn is windy
sentences.chinese: 秋风萧瑟。

sentences.content: Be careful of fires.
sentences.english: Be careful of fires
sentences.chinese: 小心火烛。

sentences.content: Sometimes there is heavy snow in winter.
sentences.english: Sometimes there is heavy snow in winter
sentences.chinese: 冬季有时会下大雪。

sentences.content: It is very cold.
sentences.english: It is very cold
sentences.chinese: 天气非常寒冷。

sentences.content: Is there any bad weather here in summer?
sentences.english: Is there any bad weather here in summer ?
sentences.chinese: 这里夏天会有恶劣天气吗？

sentences.content: Yes. There is heavy rain.
sentences.english: Yes . There is heavy rain
sentences.chinese: 是的。雨下得很大。

wordDetails.definition: be（现在时第三人称单数）: 是

sentences.content: Sometimes there are floods.
sentences.english: Sometimes there are floods
sentences.chinese: 有时会发生洪水。

sentences.content: Place, Today, Tomorrow
sentences.english: Place , Today , Tomorrow
sentences.chinese: 地点，今天，明天

sentences.content: Good morning!
sentences.english: Good morning !
sentences.chinese: 早上好！

sentences.content: This is the world weather report.
sentences.english: This is the world weather report
sentences.chinese: 这是全球天气预报。

sentences.content: In London, there will be heavy rain today.
sentences.english: In London , there will be heavy rain today
sentences.chinese: 伦敦今日将有暴雨。

sentences.content: Tomorrow, it will be cloudy.
sentences.english: Tomorrow , it will be cloudy
sentences.chinese: 明天将会是多云天气。

sentences.content: You can go outside and enjoy the cool weather!
sentences.english: You can go outside and enjoy the cool weather !
sentences.chinese: 你可以出去享受凉爽的天气了！

sentences.content: Things you should know before mountain hiking
sentences.english: Things you should know before mountain hiking
sentences.chinese: 登山前你应该知道的事

sentences.content: Hiking in the mountains can be a lot of fun, but there are some things you should know:
sentences.english: Hiking in the mountains can be a lot of fun , but there are some things you should know :
sentences.chinese: 在山间徒步旅行乐趣无穷，但有几件事你需要了解：

sentences.content: Be careful of bad weather.
sentences.english: Be careful of bad weather
sentences.chinese: 注意恶劣天气。

sentences.content: Don't go hiking in bad weather!
sentences.english: Don't go hiking in bad weather !
sentences.chinese: 恶劣天气下切勿徒步旅行！

wordDetails.definition: hike（现在分词）: 徒步旅行

sentences.content: In summer there is heavy rain and in winter there is heavy snow.
sentences.english: In summer there is heavy rain and in winter there is heavy snow
sentences.chinese: 夏季大雨倾盆，冬季大雪纷飞。

sentences.content: Bring enough water.
sentences.english: Bring enough water
sentences.chinese: 带足水。

sentences.content: In the mountains there is often little clean water, so bring enough water with you.
sentences.english: In the mountains there is often little clean water , so bring enough water with you
sentences.chinese: 山区通常缺乏干净的饮用水，因此请随身携带足够的饮用水。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.content: Wear good hiking shoes and the right clothes.
sentences.english: Wear good hiking shoes and the right clothes
sentences.chinese: 穿上合适的登山鞋和衣物。

sentences.content: It is very important to wear the right shoes.
sentences.english: It is very important to wear the right shoes
sentences.chinese: 穿对鞋子非常重要。

sentences.content: It is often windy in the mountains too, so bring a jacket with you.
sentences.english: It is often windy in the mountains too , so bring a jacket with you
sentences.chinese: 山区也经常刮风，所以记得带件夹克。

sentences.content: Tell people about your trip.
sentences.english: Tell people about your trip
sentences.chinese: 告诉大家你的旅行经历。

sentences.content: Tell your parents and friends before you go.
sentences.english: Tell your parents and friends before you go
sentences.chinese: 出发前告诉你的父母和朋友。

sentences.content: They need to know where you are.
sentences.english: They need to know where you are
sentences.chinese: 他们需要知道你在哪里。

sentences.content: What should people take with them?
sentences.english: What should people take with them ?
sentences.chinese: 人们应该随身携带什么？

sentences.content: Wear good hiking shoes and bring a jacket.
sentences.english: Wear good hiking shoes and bring a jacket
sentences.chinese: 穿一双好的登山鞋，并带上一件夹克。

sentences.content: Bring enough water with you on the trip.
sentences.english: Bring enough water with you on the trip
sentences.chinese: 旅行时带足水。

sentences.content: What should/shouldn't people do?
sentences.english: What should/shouldn't people do ?
sentences.chinese: 人们应该/不应该做什么？

sentences.content: Check the weather before you go.
sentences.english: Check the weather before you go
sentences.chinese: 出行前查看天气。

sentences.content: Don't go hiking in bad weather.
sentences.english: Don't go hiking in bad weather
sentences.chinese: 不要在恶劣天气下徒步旅行。

sentences.content: Tell your parents and friends before you go.
sentences.english: Tell your parents and friends before you go
sentences.chinese: 出发前告诉你的父母和朋友。

sentences.content: Write three tips for going to the sea in hot weather.
sentences.english: Write three tips for going to the sea in hot weather
sentences.chinese: 炎炎夏日海边出游的三个小贴士

sentences.content: The sun is strong.
sentences.english: The sun is strong
sentences.chinese: 阳光强烈。

sentences.content: You should wear a hat and sunglasses.
sentences.english: You should wear a hat and sunglasses
sentences.chinese: 你应该戴顶帽子和太阳镜。

sentences.content: You should also wear cool clothes on your trip.
sentences.english: You should also wear cool clothes on your trip
sentences.chinese: 旅行时你还应该穿凉爽的衣服。

sentences.content: And bring enough water with you.
sentences.english: And bring enough water with you
sentences.chinese: 并随身携带足够的水。

sentences.content: Be careful of the waves.
sentences.english: Be careful of the waves
sentences.chinese: 当心海浪。

sentences.content: Please make sure you stay safe.
sentences.english: Please make sure you stay safe
sentences.chinese: 请务必注意安全。
